in_arabic.name: زايد
in_arabic.long_meaning: زايد هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'زاد' الذي يعني الزيادة في الخير والنمو. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بمعاني الازدهار والتقدم والنماء في مختلف المجالات، سواء كانت مادية أو روحانية. وقد وردت مشتقات هذا الفعل في القرآن الكريم، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة دينية وروحانية كبيرة.

in_urdu.name: زائد
in_urdu.long_meaning: زائد ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خیر و برکت میں اضافہ۔ یہ نام 'زاد' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بڑھنا یا اضافہ ہونا۔ اسلامی تقليد میں، یہ نام اچھے کاموں میں اضافہ اور روحاني ترقی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ज़ायद
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़ायद एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुख और समृद्धि में वृद्धि। यह नाम 'ज़ाद' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बढ़ना या वृद्धि होना। यह नाम अच्छे कार्यों में वृद्धि और आध्यात्मिक विकास का प्रतीक है, जो इसे हिंदू-मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण बनाता है।

in_pashto.name: زېږيد
in_pashto.meaning: په خير او برکت کې زياتوالی
in_pashto.long_meaning: زېږيد د عربي نوم دی چې معنی یې په خير او برکت کې زياتوالی دی. دا نوم د 'زاد' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ودې یا زياتوالي څخه عبارت دی. په پښتنو او افغانانو کې، دا نوم د نیکمرغۍ او روحاني ودې نښه ده.

in_english.name: Zaaid
in_english.meaning: increase, growth in goodness and prosperity
in_english.long_meaning: Zaaid is an Arabic name derived from the root 'zaad', meaning increase or growth. It symbolizes enhancement in goodness, prosperity, and spiritual growth. Referenced in the Quran, this name holds significant religious and spiritual value, representing advancement in various aspects of life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zaaid holds a significant cultural impact, reflecting the traditional Islamic values of protecting and defending the weak, the vulnerable and the helpless. The name Zaaid is a reminder of the societal responsibilities and obligations towards community, family and humanity. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) himself was a patron and protector, famously advocating for justice, equality and the rights of the oppressed. By bestowing the name Zaaid upon a child, the parents are encouraging the development of strong moral character and a lifetime dedication towards guardianship and protection.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Zaaid holds a deep significance as an embodiment of the divine trait of Qahfi - the Protector, a reference to Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala (exalted is He), as one who shelters and shields His creation from harm. The name connects the bearer to a divine purpose of being a guardian and protector, a valued characteristic in Islam, and inspiring them to be an agent of good and a shield to their loved ones. The spiritual essence of the name Zaaid also calls upon the person to develop the inner qualities of courage, strength, wisdom and righteousness, as they embark on their journey towards personal growth and development, in accordance with Allah's will.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Sa'd, Al-Tabaqat Al-Kabir, Volume 2, Page 126. The name Zaaid carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.time_period: 7th century - Early 8th century, Arabian Peninsula, Umayyad Caliphate.
historical_references.context: Zaaid ibn Harithah was a descendant of the Prophet Muhammad's uncle, Al-'Abbas ibn 'Abdul-Muttalib. He was a prominent warrior during the Umayyad Caliphate and participated in several military campaigns led by Marwan I. Zaaid's bravery and loyalty to the Umayyad dynasty were renowned.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Baladhuri, Ansab Al-Ashraf, Volume 1, Page 132. The name Zaaid carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.time_period: Late 7th century, Arabian Peninsula, Early Umayyad Caliphate.
historical_references.context: Zaaid ibn Al-Harith was a son of Harith ibn Kalidah Al-Kindi. He was a cousin of 'Ali ibn Al-Husain Al-Sajjad. Zaaid served as an emissary during the early Umayyad Caliphate, representing the interests of the Umayyad rulers to various tribal leaders in the Arabian Peninsula.

modern_usage.modern_context: Zaaid is a modern Islamic name with growing popularity. It originates from the Arabic language and means 'giver' or 'helper'. This name is seen on various platforms, including social media where it is used as a unique username, on baby naming websites as a popular choice for parents looking for a meaningful name for their child, and in Islamic communities as a name for newborn babies. The trend towards modern Islamic names reflects the desire to honor traditional Islamic values while also embracing contemporary culture and individual expression.

name_in_real_life.story: Fatima Zaaid, a teacher in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, shares that their name Zaaid meaning "Protector, Guardian" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Zaaid is believed to mean "one who is generous and bountiful, always giving and providing for others". It is derived from the Arabic root 'z-d-d', which connotes generosity, liberality, and abundance. May Allah (SWT) grant us all the ability to embody this beautiful trait in our daily lives.
